title: Compact Discmas Assorted Favorites From Xmassettes Past CD Christmas Indie
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Compact Discmas - Assorted Favorites from Xmassettes Past.

A tenth-year retrospective collecting favorites from a run of annual
homemade Christmas cassettes recorded from 1988 onward, compiled in
October 1997. All songs arranged and produced by Michael LeFevre;
associate producer Brian Newbury; CD mastering by Dave Bron, SoundZone,
Burbank.

An unusual small-run independent Christmas release. See the photographed
insert for the liner note and credits.

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
